source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Meta if its first-session utm_campaign is one of "Sales Ads – Copy" / "Sales Ads" / "Sales Ads | Retargeting | Add to Cart", OR first-session source is "Facebook" / "Instagram" / "android-app://m.facebook.com/" (case-insensitive). Checked only after DM-Ad — an order already claimed by DM-Ad never lands here.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. Standalone page, built 2026-07-27.
